name: Grounding Bolt
reqs: 90s LTN, 90r LHT OR 90r MED OR 90r HVY
additional_info: 10 second cooldown. Procs on lightning strikes caused from Scorched Peak, Fulgurite Formation, the Specialist Set equipment Talents, Storm/Stormbreaker enchantments during the rain, and the random lightning strikes from the Stormbreaker Enchantment.
desc: Your lightning strikes now apply Grounded, uppercutting an opponent with this effect will strike them with a bolt of non-grounding lightning.
